Session date: 10:47 am on 6 May, 2023
[D5:1] Andrew: Hey! Since we last spoke, I've been looking for a doggo to adopt - browsing websites, visiting shelters and asking friends of theirs. It's been both fun and annoying!
[D5:1] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog looking through a cage at the camera
[D5:2] Audrey: Sounds like a fun and demanding task! Getting to meet new pups must bring so much happiness. What  do you think you can do to make the process smoother?
[D5:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouth
[D5:3] Andrew: Meeting all these adorable pups has been awesome! For those considering getting a pup, the size of living space and the exercise needs of the breed are important. For me, a person living in an apartment, a smaller dog would be best, but if one is active, consider getting one that loves to play and run.
[D5:4] Audrey: That's some good advice! It's important to consider the space and energy needs of a dog.
[D5:5] Andrew: Yeah! Finding a pet-friendly place to live has been tough too. I'm contacting landlords and checking out neighborhoods to find the perfect spot.
[D5:6] Audrey: Guessing it's tough to find housing. Any particular part of town you want to live in?
[D5:7] Andrew: I'm looking for a place near a park or woods, so I can stay close to nature and give the dog a large open space to run around
[D5:8] Audrey: That's a good plan! I'm lucky to have a park near me - it's great for my pup's walks. Last Friday we took a road trip - we went to a beautiful national park and my dogs had a blast! It was an awesome trip!
[D5:8] Image caption (automatic): a photography of three dogs running through a field of grass
[D5:9] Andrew: Nice! Glad the pups had a great road trip. Do you take them on road trips often?
[D5:10] Audrey: I take them on road trips once every couple of months. It's a great way for them to explore and stay active.
[D5:11] Andrew: Wow, that's awesome! I really wish I could go on a road trip with a furry companion.
[D5:12] Audrey: It's a cool experience. Having your furry friends on a road trip is an amazing experience. They make it really fun and exciting. It's definitely something to look forward to!
[D5:13] Andrew: Adding that to my bucket list! Can't wait for the day I actually go on a trip with my dog!
[D5:14] Audrey: Good luck with your search! Fingers crossed you find the perfect one.
[D5:15] Andrew: Thanks! Your help is much appreciated. I'm still on the lookout for the perfect furry friend.
[D5:16] Audrey: Not a problem, I'm glad to help! Good luck with your search!
[D5:17] Andrew: Thanks! I'll let you know how it goes. 
[D5:18] Audrey: Definitely, keep me posted and let me know if you need any suggestions or help.
[D5:19] Andrew: Will do! Really apprecieate it. 
[D5:20] Audrey: Yup! You got it, I'll be expecting a pic of your dog soon! :)
[D5:21] Andrew: Haha I can't wait. I'll ttyl, gotta check out another shelter soon.
[D5:22] Audrey: Have fun! Ttyl!
Session date: 2:03 pm on 11 May, 2023
[D6:1] Andrew: Hi Audrey! I had a great hike last weekend with some friends and my girlfriend at the spot we found recently. Nature was so peaceful – it was so nice to just relax and take it in. How's your week been? Anything exciting going on lately?
[D6:1] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dirt path leading to a grassy hill
[D6:2] Audrey: Hey Andrew! That hike sounds great. Nature is good for the soul, right? My week's been good - taking care of my four doggies and making sure they're happy and healthy took up most of my free time. Also, exciting news! I signed up for a workshop about bonding with my pet next month. Can't wait to learn new stuff and strengthen my bond with my pets. What's up with you?
[D6:2] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a group of dogs with a yellow circle
[D6:3] Andrew: That's awesome! Glad have the opportunity to bond with your pets. That workshop sounds cool. Where did you hear about it? And the one in the picture is adorable!
[D6:4] Audrey: I know right? I saw this workshop flyer at my local pet store. It was a positive reinforcement training class and I wanted to give it a shot. The volunteer in the store was nice enough to let me meet their dog – he was so friendly and playful!
[D6:5] Andrew: Cool! Positive reinforcement can really help you bond with your dogs. Do you think they'll catch on quickly?
[D6:6] Audrey: I'm sure they'll catch on really quick! They're quick learners and love rewards! Can't wait to learn how to train them better.
[D6:7] Andrew: That's awesome! Keep me updated on their progress.
[D6:8] Audrey: Definitely! I'll keep you updated on how it all goes and how my pups are doing. Fingers crossed they'll be extra behaved. And I'll let you know some tips on training your future dog as well!
[D6:9] Andrew: Thanks! I'm excited to hear about it. Have a great time at the workshop!
[D6:10] Audrey: I'll definitely have a good time and make the most of it. I'm sure this is a must learn for any dog owner.
[D6:11] Andrew: You think so? Wow, you must be a good salesperson because I'm almost sold on this class haha.
[D6:12] Audrey: Haha, I just think its important to have pets learn how to behave on a positive reinforcement way. Punishment is never the proper way for pets ya know?
[D6:13] Andrew: Yeah I would't want to be punished, let alone puppies and dogs.
[D6:14] Audrey: Right!? I don't want to hurt any of my dogs. Just by thinking of it gives me pain.
[D6:15] Andrew: Yeah I feel you. Anyways, let me look into their classes. I'll talk to you soon, have fun!
[D6:16] Audrey: Yup, ttyl!
Session date: 11:27 am on 2 June, 2023

[D7:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two horses in a field with a fence

Session date: 4:22 pm on 13 October, 2023
[D23:1] Andrew: Hey Audrey, it's been a busy week for me. Last Tuesday, my gf, Toby, and I had a really awesome night playing board games. It was really nice. What's been up with you lately?
[D23:1] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog sitting at a chess board with a chess set in front of him
[D23:2] Audrey: Hey! Sounds like you've been busy! I made some goodies recently to thank my neighbors for their pup-friendly homes. It was a nice way to bring some joy around here. Any plans for the weekend?
[D23:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a pan of cookies on a wooden table
[D23:3] Andrew: Friday night's board game session was a nice break. This weekend, I'm planning to check out this cozy cafe and hang out there.
[D23:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people sitting at a table in a room
[D23:4] Audrey: That cafe looks really cozy! Any other spots you would recommend?
[D23:5] Andrew: So this new spot just opened the other day. It's awesome with a sick view and vibe.
[D23:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man sitting on a couch in a large open space
[D23:6] Audrey: Wow, looks great! Can I bring my pups with me?
[D23:7] Andrew: Hmmm, not sure if it's suitable for them but hey, there's a great dog park close by! Maybe we can bring our coffee over.
[D23:8] Audrey: Sounds good! Exploring new places is always an adventure for them.
[D23:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog wearing a sweater sitting in the grass
[D23:9] Andrew: Aww, they look so sweet in that sweater! Do they enjoy going to the dog park?
[D23:10] Audrey: The dog park is like paradise for them! They love socializing with the other pups and getting lots of exercise. It's so cute to watch them running around and smelling all the stuff. Do you have any funny stories about your pup at the dog park?
[D23:10] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs playing with a frisbee in a field
[D23:11] Andrew: There was this one time my pup got too excited and chased a squirrel. He ran around the tree and the squirrel just watched from the branches. It was hilarious!
[D23:11] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog playing with a frisbee in a field
[D23:12] Audrey: Haha, that must've been hilarious! What breed is your pup again? He looks so fun! My dogs love running around the park. But one thing they hate is snow. I took them to a snowy one last winter and they were so confused! They definitely prefer nice, sunny days in the grass.
[D23:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog wearing a shirt standing on a hardwood floor
[D23:13] Andrew: My pup Toby is German Shephard and loves cute sweaters! He's so active. What games do your dogs like to play at the park?
[D23:14] Audrey: My dogs go crazy for Fetch and Frisbee, and they love to run around and meet other pups. They could keep running for hours!
[D23:15] Andrew: That sounds like so much fun! It's great to see them happy and active.
[D23:16] Audrey: Yeah, it's awesome! Seeing them happy fills my heart with joy. They bring me so much happiness.
[D23:16] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog and a teddy bear sleeping on a couch
[D23:17] Andrew: Yeah, they really do bring joy don't they. It's wonderful.
[D23:18] Audrey: I think i've said this so many times, but I really can't imagine my life without them - my little family. They always make me smile and give lots of love and companionship. Remember I had a tattoo of my four dogs? So I went to the tattoo parlor and got some more drawings on the tattoo.
[D23:18] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a tattoo of a flower on a wrist
[D23:19] Andrew: Wow, that's cool! Any plans on getting more? Or are you finished?
[D23:20] Audrey: Thanks! I think right now its enough. Unless someday I decide to get another dog. Maybe I'll get another tattoo when that happens.
[D23:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman with a tattoo of a dog and sunflowers
[D23:21] Andrew: I can tell they're a real source of love for you. It's great to have that kind of inspiration. You know what else inspires me? Somewhere like this
[D23:21] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a path in the woods with a forest in the background
[D23:22] Audrey: They really bring me joy. It feels great to experience unconditional love! Do you ever get the chance to visit forests like that? Bet it's an amazing escape for you.
[D23:23] Andrew: Yeah, living in the city, I do miss nature a lot. Whenever I can, I try to go to nearby parks or on hikes. It's such a peaceful and joyful experience for me.
[D23:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman walking up a steep hill with a view of the ocean
[D23:24] Audrey: Yeah you're so right about needing nature time. Life's been crazy lately so it's been a while since I took my furry friends out for a walk. But those moments with them in nature are just so chill and happy! They're definitely the best companions for exploring the great outdoors.
[D23:25] Andrew: Totally agree! Nature and animals can be so peaceful and joyful. I hope you and your furry buddies go on some fun adventures soon!
[D23:26] Audrey: Yeah, I need to go on a hike with them, it's going to be a great therapy!
[D23:27] Andrew: Yeah! You've hiked with your dogs, it's a fun way to bond and make memories.
[D23:28] Audrey: Yup, I still remember everytime we all go on a hiking strip with my dog. Good times.
Session date: 6:12 pm on 19 October, 2023

Session date: 1:10 pm on 27 March, 2023
[D1:1] Audrey: Hey Andrew! Good to see ya! What's been up since we last talked?
[D1:2] Andrew: Hey Audrey! So, I started a new job as a Financial Analyst last week - it's been quite a change from my previous job. How about you? Anything interesting happening?
[D1:3] Audrey: Congrats on the new job! So I got these new collars and tags for my dogs - so cute!
[D1:4] Andrew: Thanks! That sounds cute. Can I see a picture?
[D1:5] Audrey: Sure! See them with their new collars, cute right?
[D1:5] Image caption (automatic): a photography of two dogs are standing in the grass with their mouths open
[D1:6] Andrew: Cute little guys! What are their names and how long have you had them?
[D1:7] Audrey: I've had them for 3 years! Their names are Pepper, Precious and Panda. I can't live without my little ones!
[D1:8] Andrew: That's awesome! Have you always wanted a dog, even with living in the city? Can they still go on adventures?
[D1:9] Audrey: Absolutely! They're city dogs and we explore all the time. They love trying out new parks and trails. We go on adventures together very often.
[D1:10] Andrew: Wow, sounds like they make life so awesome! Kinda jealous of all those fun outings with them.
[D1:11] Audrey: They really do! It's great how much happiness they bring. Do you have any pets?
[D1:12] Andrew: No, no pets right now. But I do love animals.
[D1:13] Audrey: That's great to hear! Animals are truly amazing. Do you have a favorite animal?
[D1:14] Andrew: I've always been awed by birds. Their power to soar and explore new spots is amazing.
[D1:15] Audrey: Yeah, birds are amazing! I can imagine it feels incredible to soar and see the world from up high. Do you have a favorite type of bird?
[D1:16] Andrew: Eagles have always mesmerized me; they're so strong and graceful!
[D1:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two birds flying in the sky with a sun shining behind them
[D1:17] Audrey: Yeah they're beautiful. Do you go bird-watching? It must be awesome to see them up close.
[D1:18] Andrew: Haven't specifically gone out for bird-watching, but I do spot them when I hike.
[D1:19] Audrey: Nice, spotting pretty birds while hiking must be great. Do you have any favorite hiking spots?
[D1:20] Andrew: Fox Hollow is a great trail to hike on weekends; the views are awesome!
[D1:21] Audrey: Cool, gonna give it a try. Thanks for the suggestion!
[D1:22] Andrew: No problem! Let me know how you like it. Have fun hiking!
[D1:23] Audrey: Thanks! I'll let you know. Have a good one!
[D1:24] Andrew: Take care and have a good one! See ya!
Session date: 2:42 pm on 2 April, 2023
[D2:1] Audrey: Hey Andrew, I got a surprise for you! We adopted another puppy called Pixie. She's SO cute! Isn't she just the cutest?
[D2:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a small white dog sitting on a carpet

[D2:5] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog playing with a group of other dogs
[D2:6] Andrew: That's awesome! Is Pepper adjusting well to her?
[D2:7] Audrey: Pepper took a bit to get used to her, but now they're always together!
[D2:7] Image caption (automatic): a photography of two dogs standing in the grass near a fence
[D2:8] Andrew: That's great to hear! I'm considering getting a dog too, but it can be challenging finding a dog-friendly place in the city. Do you have any tips on finding such a place?
[D2:9] Audrey: We used websites that helped us find a place that allowed dogs. They had filters that made it super easy. Found a perfect spot thanks to them!
[D2:9] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog sitting in a field of flowers
[D2:10] Andrew: Wow, that's so cool! I'll give those websites a try, thanks for the info!
[D2:11] Audrey: You got it! I hope you find a great spot soon!
[D2:12] Andrew: Thanks! Fingers crossed for the apartment and that furry friend.
[D2:13] Audrey: I'm keeping my fingers crossed for you to find a great furry friend and an apartment.
[D2:14] Andrew: Hope I find one soon. Can't wait!
[D2:15] Audrey: You'll love them! They're great for cuddles and companionship.
[D2:16] Andrew: It'd be so great to have a furry buddy to cuddle and hang with. Here's a photo of my family's dog on a couch. 
[D2:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog sitting on a couch in a living room
[D2:17] Audrey: Our furry friends make great cuddle buddies. Here's one of them enjoying some lazy couch time!
[D2:17] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog laying on a couch with a pillow
[D2:18] Andrew: That pic is so cute! It would be fun to hang out with a dog, cuddling away. Got me thinking of my old hiking pics and how much I miss exploring nature trails with my family's dog. Ah, the peaceful moments out in nature!
[D2:18] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man walking a dog on a trail
[D2:19] Audrey:  Taking them on hikes must be awesome! That makes me want to hike with my dogs.
[D2:20] Andrew: Hiking with a dog is way fun, it's a great way to bond and create memories together.
[D2:20] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a man sitting on a rock with a dog
[D2:21] Audrey: Yeah! Exploring nature with them and making memories is awesome!
[D2:22] Andrew: Definitely! I miss those moments. I need to find a dog-friendly spot soon so I can get exploring again!
[D2:23] Audrey: Yep! I hope you find the perfect dog-friendly spot soon so you can make new memories with them.
[D2:24] Andrew: Thanks! I'll keep looking until I find it. Super excited for what's next!
[D2:25] Audrey: So excited for you! I can't wait to see where you and your furry friend decide to hang out. All the best!
[D2:26] Andrew: I'll keep you posted. Ttyl, Bye!
Session date: 4:19 pm on 16 April, 2023
[D3:1] Andrew: Hey Audrey! What's up? Missed chatting with ya! Check it out, my girl & I tried out that new cafe scene in the city last weekend! Super fun but kinda sad not being out in nature - that's when I feel like I'm really thriving. Oh man, I miss the peacefulness of being out on a hike.
[D3:2] Audrey: Hey Andrew! That cafe sounds pretty awesome, glad you enjoyed it. Yeah, I know what you mean. That feeling of being out in nature, surrounded by beauty and peace, is unbeatable, compared to being surrounded by concrete jungles. 
[D3:3] Andrew: Yeah, being out in the nature really has a way of taking my breath away. It's like a home for my soul! I feel connected when I'm there.
[D3:4] Audrey: I totally get it. Nature has a way of bringing us back down to earth and reminding us that we're part of something bigger. It's amazing.
[D3:5] Andrew: Yeah, it's like hitting the reset button when life gets too chaotic. Nature has a way of being really soothing.
[D3:6] Audrey: Definitely! For me, taking my dogs for a walk in the park helps me find my center and recharges me.

Session date: 12:24 am on 24 August, 2023

Here's a photo of the trip to the lake with my friend.

[D17:8] Audrey: Yeah, my dogs make me really happy. I love them so much and I want to make them as happy as possible. We have a strong bond.
[D17:9] Andrew: That's amazing. You have such a strong bond with them! I hope I can have such a strong bond with Toby as well.
[D17:10] Audrey: They mean the world to me. I'm so lucky to have them. I sure with your love, you and Toby can have a strong bond.
[D17:11] Andrew: Lucky you! Pets sure bring a lot of love and joy. Can't wait till Toby and I bond better.
[D17:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog sleeping in a dog bed on the floor
[D17:12] Audrey: Thanks! That's really nice. Let me know if you need some tips on taking care of Toby.
[D17:13] Andrew: Sure thing! I'll try figure it on my own first. Appreciate the help!
[D17:14] Audrey: Remember, it takes time to form a bond, don't rush!

[D17:16] Audrey: No problem. Let me know if you have any questions or need advice.

[D17:17] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a small dog sitting on a floor with a leash
[D17:18] Audrey: Aww so cute! Toby looks happy!
[D17:19] Andrew: Haha yeah, I do love Toby!
[D17:20] Audrey: I'm glad Toby is happy. I'm sure there are lots of adventures to come!
[D17:21] Andrew: Yep, Toby and I are gonna have a blast exploring outdoors! Can't wait.
Session date: 7:49 pm on 6 September, 2023
[D18:1] Andrew: Hey Audrey, how's it going? Since we last talked, a few new things have come up in my life. Work's been tough and stressful, so my outdoor activities have taken a backseat. Finding balance has been challenging.
[D18:2] Audrey: Hey Andrew, good to hear from you. Sorry to hear about work being tough. Finding that balance can be challenging, huh? It can feel like there's not enough time. Just remember to take care of yourself and find ways to manage stress. Hang in there!
[D18:3] Andrew: Thanks! It's tough, but I guess that's just part of life, huh? How do you make sure you have enough time for yourself?
[D18:4] Audrey: Yeah, it's tough to find time for yourself. I make sure to do at least one self-care activity each day - like treating myself to something nice. Don't forget to take care of yourself and have some fun too!
[D18:5] Andrew: Yeah, self-care is really important isn't it. I've been adding simple things to my day like grabbing a coffee in the morning or going for a walk at lunch. It kinda helps me recharge and chill out a little.
[D18:6] Audrey: That's great! Glad you found ways to relax. It's nice to have those little moments of joy. Something cool recently happened with my furry friends - I organized a doggy playdate with the neighbors' dogs. Seeing all those tails wagging was so sweet. They must have had so much fun!
[D18:7] Andrew: That's awesome. I bet they all had a blast! Got any pics from that day?
[D18:8] Audrey: Here's a pic from the playdate. It was great seeing them having fun together. Their joy was infectious and made my heart feel so full.
[D18:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs playing in a fenced in area
[D18:9] Andrew: That's so heartwarming! Seeing them enjoy themselves like that is always a joy. :)
[D18:10] Audrey: I'm so happy seeing them have a great time. Last week I even got some new beds for them, just to give them some extra comfort now the weather's cooling down and they were happy! It's incredible how such a simple thing can bring them so much happiness.
[D18:11] Andrew: Animals can really find joy in the simple things. That was so nice of you. Do you have any pictures of the new beds?
[D18:12] Audrey: Sure! Here's a pic of them. Super cozy and comfy. My furry friends love them!
[D18:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog laying on a dog bed in a living room
[D18:13] Andrew: Do they enjoy snoozing on it? It looks really comfy!
[D18:14] Audrey: They absolutely love it! They curl up and snuggle like they're in a cloud - it's adorable!
[D18:15] Andrew: That's really cute! Animals really know how to be happy with the simple stuff. Last weekend I got away for a hike and it was such a relief to get away from the city. Here's a photo of the beautiful sunset I witnessed during my hike.
[D18:15] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a person on a mountain with a view of the city
[D18:16] Audrey: Nice escape! Glad you got out hiking. Are you planning to hike with Toby someday?
[D18:17] Andrew: Yeah, I've been wanting to for a while, but it's a bit difficult since Toby is still so young.
[D18:18] Audrey: Did you find a dog-friendly place to live yet? I remember you mentioning it.
[D18:19] Andrew: Nah, still working on that. It's been a bit challenging.
[D18:20] Audrey: Keep going, you'll find a great place to live for your pet soon!
[D18:21] Andrew: Thanks! I appreciate the help. I'll keep searching for that perfect place for dogs!
[D18:22] Audrey: No worries! You got this. Don't give up. Take care!
Session date: 5:53 pm on 24 September, 2023
[D19:1] Andrew: Hey Audrey! Long time no talk! How have you been?
[D19:2] Audrey: Hey! I'm alright. Had some bumps though - last Friday at the park one of my pups saw something and pulled so hard the leash busted. Scared that she might run off and get hurt, so I had to chase after her. Luckily I caught her before anything bad happened. Little moments like this remind me how important she is and how we should be careful when we're out there.
[D19:2] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a red retractable leash with a black handle
[D19:3] Andrew: Oh man, sorry to hear that! I'm totally getting anxious just thinking about my dog getting lost. Precious must have been really scared. What did you do to calm her down?

Session date: 9:48 am on 8 July, 2023
[D11:3] Andrew: That's awesome! Dogs really make life more fun doesn't it. I wish I could get one, but like I said, it's tough to find a place and find the right dog. How did you get yours?
[D11:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog wearing a sweater sitting in the grass
[D11:4] Audrey: Thanks! I got lucky finding a breeder nearby that has the dogs I wanted. Yeah places that allows dogs are really hard to find unfortunately .
[D11:5] Andrew: Yeah it's tough. I found a few parks where you can take your pup on a leash, but it's not the same as having an open area where they can run and play. If I find something, I'll let you know. 
[D11:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of dogs running around a park
[D11:6] Audrey: Cool, I should join you for a hike and bring my dogs. It would be great to have a chance where they can run freely.
[D11:7] Andrew: Yeah definitely ! I'm down for a hike with you and your furry friends. Let's do it next month when the weather is more pleasant. Here's the trail that I think it'd be great for the dogs.
[D11:7] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman walking up a steep hill with a view of the ocean
[D11:8] Audrey: That'd be awesome! I can't wait to take them hiking. Fingers crossed we find a spot with a great view and lots of room for them to explore and have a blast.
[D11:9] Andrew: Looking forward to seeing them have fun hiking. Let's get planning for next month! Here's the map for the trail.
[D11:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a map of a park with a lot of trees
[D11:10] Audrey: Yep! I'm gonna look into the trail for my furry friend to run around.
[D11:11] Andrew: Sounds good! Let's make sure the trail is safe for the dogs to run around and have fun.
[D11:12] Audrey: Yep! After all safety is top priority when the dogs are outside running around.
[D11:13] Andrew: Agreed! It's going to be a great with the dogs!
[D11:14] Audrey: Yup! Btw, there's going to be some cool stuff happening today.
[D11:14] Image caption (automatic): a photo of three dogs sitting on the floor with leashes
[D11:15] Andrew: Woah! They look so cute! What is going on here? They look ready for an adventure.
[D11:16] Audrey: Haha yeah! They're all set for their next outdoor adventure!
[D11:17] Andrew: Aw man, can't wait to meet them! They seem like a blast!
[D11:18] Audrey: Yeah, they definitely do! They really are a lot of fun.
[D11:19] Andrew: Oh I'm sure, dogs definitely add lots of fun to our daily life.
[D11:20] Audrey: Yep! They bring me so much joy. Can't get bored at all.
[D11:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouth
[D11:21] Andrew: Aww, they look adorable playing in the park! Seeing them have so much fun must be so rewarding.
[D11:22] Audrey: Yeah it sure does. Seeing them so happy and bouncy makes me really happy.
[D11:23] Andrew: Yep, they're so happy it's contagious. It makes me happy just by looking at the photos.
[D11:24] Audrey: Haha that's great! They're so full of energy, always bringing a smile to my face!
[D11:25] Andrew: They make everyone smile. Can't wait to go hiking with them!
[D11:26] Audrey: Yep! It'll be great to see them enjoy themselves on the hike!
[D11:27] Andrew: Yep! I can't wait to see them have fun on the hike. Super excited!
[D11:28] Audrey: I'm 100% sure that it's gonna be a great day! Just take a look how happy my dogs are just at out local park.
[D11:28] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog playing with a group of other dogs
[D11:29] Andrew: Aww look at them, so cute! It'll definitely be a great day! I love being outdoors and seeing others enjoy it too.
[D11:30] Audrey: Yeah! Being outside and seeing people happy is awesome. Here's a pic from a hike last year. Such a pretty sunset!
[D11:30] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person standing on a mountain with a view of the sky
[D11:31] Andrew: Wow, that's stunning! Mind telling me where this is? 
[D11:32] Audrey: I hiked this last year! It was a 3 hour drive from me and the sunset was amazing!
[D11:33] Andrew: Nice! That sunset with the view is amazing, especially with nature around.
[D11:34] Audrey: It was a beautiful moment indeed! The colors were so vibrant, and it felt so peaceful. I'm so grateful for moments like these that remind me of the beauty of nature and to appreciate the small things.
[D11:34] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a view of a lake and mountains at sunset
[D11:35] Andrew: Yeah! It's incredible how nature can have such awesome surprises.
[D11:36] Audrey: Nature really has awesome surprises. All those vibrant colors gives me that feeling of peace - it's breathtaking!
[D11:37] Andrew: Yeah! It is stunning! Life's pretty awesome when we take time to appreciate these moments right?
[D11:38] Audrey: Yep, taking a second to appreciate those moments makes like much better!
Session date: 10:05 am on 11 July, 2023
[D12:1] Andrew: Hey! So much has changed since last time we talked - meet Toby, my puppy. He's a bundle of joy and I couldn't resist taking him home, city living and all. How've you been?
[D12:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog sitting on a leash in a room
[D12:2] Audrey: OMG! Toby looks so adorable! Congrats on your new addition. I'm sure you're really happy right now! I so happy for you!
[D12:3] Andrew: Haha yeah! Toby's definitely bringing a lot of joy. Since we last talked, work has been piling up and I've been stuck inside. I miss the peace and feeling of freedom that comes with going for a hike.
[D12:4] Audrey: Yeah you're really stressed then! When work's non-stop, it's hard to get outdoors. Hiking is a great way to relax and take in nature. Do you have plans to go hiking soon? We should plan a trip for both of us and our pups!
[D12:5] Andrew: Yeah work's been stressful lately and I need a break. I have plans for a hike next month and thought it'd be cool if you and the pups could come along. We can enjoy nature and have a fun time!
[D12:6] Audrey: Sounds great! I'm in for the hike, and my dogs can come too. Thanks for inviting us! I made these personalized tags for them. Take a look! 
[D12:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of wooden keychains with engraved names
[D12:7] Andrew: Wow, those look great! Did you make them? It's really cool!
[D12:8] Audrey: Thanks! Yeah, I made them myself. I wanted each one to be special and fit their personalities.
[D12:9] Andrew: Wow, that's so cool. You really put so much love into making them, which makes them extra special.
[D12:10] Audrey: Thanks! I did put a lot of love into making these tags. I want my pets to feel seen and loved.
[D12:11] Andrew: It really are the small things like these show we care a ton about out pets.
[D12:12] Audrey: Yep! Small acts of love like that make a big difference in our relationships with our furry pals. Let's make sure they know how much we care!
[D12:13] Andrew: Definitely! They bring us so much joy, so it's only fair that we show them how special they are. Can't wait for our hike - and for Toby and your pups to meet!
[D12:14] Audrey: Can't wait either! It's going to be loads of fun and a great memory.
[D12:15] Andrew: Yep! It'll be an adventure alright.
